heading: Education & nonprofit use cases
intro: Every use case comes from a real Fruition client engagement, with the client's name withheld. Select "See the build" for the process diagram, boards, automations and integrations.

faq.question: What do education & nonprofit organisations build on monday.com with Fruition?
faq.answer: This page shows 7 education & nonprofit use cases. The most common are work & project management (6), CRM (4), integrations & migration (4), most often for operations & delivery, customer service, marketing teams.

faq.question: How long does a education & nonprofit monday.com build take?
faq.answer: The most common timeframe for a complete education & nonprofit build is 3 to 6 months. Phased programs run longer, with later phases added once the core build is adopted.

faq.question: Which systems do education & nonprofit builds integrate with?
faq.answer: The integrations that come up most often in education & nonprofit use cases are Make, Better Impact, SuperForms, Email inbox, Google Drive, HubSpot.

faq.question: Does Fruition build AI agents for education & nonprofit?
faq.answer: Yes. 3 of the education & nonprofit use cases on this page include an AI step. Examples: Phase 2: AI-assisted sentiment priority and one-line case title/summary; AI categorises incoming requests into ticket categories; Explored: AI to summarise marketing chat conversations and extract lead details.

useCases.title: Independent school events team
useCases.summary: Event planning and requests were spread across email and cluttered boards, with no central ticketing, inconsistent task tracking and little visibility of team workload.
useCases.challenge: Event planning and requests were spread across email and cluttered boards, with no central ticketing, inconsistent task tracking and little visibility of team workload.
boards: Workspace audit and consolidation
Events board restructured by stage with term and week columns
Personalised My Work views per team member
Service ticketing: shared and personal inboxes connected, categories, statuses, response templates
Reporting dashboards: ticket volume, response times, task completion, individual workload
automations: Event date → automatic grouping into upcoming/in progress/completed
Inbound email → ticket auto-assigned by routing rules
Ticket status change → linked event item updated
Deadline approaching/overdue → reminder and notification
AI categorises incoming requests into ticket categories
useCases.outcome: Centralised communication and task management, faster responses to enquiries, standardised event processes, better reporting and less manual work.

process.title: Event requests ticketed, routed and tracked

useCases.title: International student education agency
useCases.summary: An education agency's core platform lacked lead funnelling, email tracking, automated reminders and flexible reporting, so leads from marketing were entered manually and follow-ups relied on staff memory.
useCases.challenge: An education agency's core platform lacked lead funnelling, email tracking, automated reminders and flexible reporting, so leads from marketing were entered manually and follow-ups relied on staff memory.
boards: Lead funnel: qualification, assignment and follow-up, with website forms and paid-social leads flowing straight in
Client profiles linked to related profiles (e.g. family members)
Stage-based pipeline dashboards
Migration of last two years of client data from Work Management with duplicate flagging
automations: Qualified lead → client created in the agency's core system with two-way sync of updates (Make)
Visa/course expiry approaching → reminder to staff and client communication
Automated follow-up reminders and segmented mass emails using migrated templates
Explored: AI to summarise marketing chat conversations and extract lead details
useCases.outcome: A CRM layer for lead capture, automated reminders and segmented email that syncs qualified leads two-way with the agency's existing system, with document management deferred.

useCases.title: Multi-site early learning operator
useCases.summary: Around 100 boards across 16 sites had to be updated by hand because templates were not centrally managed, dashboards hit board limits, and recruitment relied on a costly, fragile chain of external automations.
useCases.challenge: Around 100 boards across 16 sites had to be updated by hand because templates were not centrally managed, dashboards hit board limits, and recruitment relied on a costly, fragile chain of external automations.
boards: Managed templates: roll board and automation changes out across ~16 sites at once
Recruitment pipeline with progressive candidate forms (Superform)
Waitlist and enrolment tracking
Portfolio-style dashboards across locations
Optional parent request portal and shared mailbox ticketing (Service)
automations: Workflow builder replacing Slack-triggered external automations
Candidate stage change → send follow-up form link
Contract generation and e-signature with signed file returned to the item
useCases.outcome: A 5-10 hour process and usage review leading to managed templates, native workflow automation and a cheaper integration layer for recruitment and enrolment.
